headline: Policy Subcommittee reviews proposed changes to Section I and Section J policies.
summary: The subcommittee will review and vote on recommended changes to Section I and Section J policies, then discuss the approval status of previously reviewed sections.
items: Review and approval of recommendations for Section I (with changes and clean version)
Review and approval of recommendations for Section J (analysis and with changes)
Discussion on previous sections' approval status
